A '''support fleet''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|fleet admiral]]. It was comprised of one [[fleet ordnance]], one [[biological]] section, one [[Astrogation (section)|astrogation]] section, one [[force technical services]], and two [[force support]]s, for an average of 500 [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. A quarter of the vessels in the support fleet were [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] sized or smaller, and a quarter were [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Field Secured Container Vessels]].
